items.title: What We Know About Jensen Huang’s Resignation

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns as $700 billion crisis deepens
items.summary: Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress has been appointed interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent replacement.

items.title: NVIDIA Stocks Plunge 10.25% as Jensen Huang Resigns and CFO Takes Interim Helm
items.summary: The board names Colette Kress interim CEO and Harvey Jones its first chair, five days before third-quarter results.

items.title: Jensen Huang Resigns, Leaving CFO Colette Kress to Run Nvidia
items.summary: The board named Harvey Jones as its first-ever chair and will look inside and outside the company for a permanent CEO

items.title: He Joined Nvidia’s Board in 1993, the Year It Was Founded. Today Harvey Jones Became Its First-Ever Chair. He Handed a Company to a Founder Once Before
items.summary: Harvey C. Jones joined Nvidia's board in 1993 and on Thursday became its first-ever chair, leading the search for Jensen Huang's permanent successor. At Synopsys he handed the CEO job to founder Aart de Geus in 1994. Nvidia was at $164.56 at 10:46 AM ET.

items.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO, With CFO Colette Kress Named Interim Chief
items.summary: The Nvidia co-founder steps down after reports of affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and a company executive, ending his 33-year run.

items.title: Who is Colette Kress, Nvidia's New Interim CEO? Finance Veteran Takes Over After Jensen Huang's Resignation.
items.summary: Kress has been appointed to lead Nvidia temporarily following Huang's departure. The AI chipmaker is already searching for a permanent successor.
